qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind facet-split reviews of the signed candidate 5f01560 and serialized rechecks of the signed fix commit 5c78e52 found the comprehensibility defect resolved; correctness, scoped coverage, cross-file consistency and quiz safety were clean throughout. 得意's second example 得意な科目は数学です no longer adds a superlative: «Предмет, который мне хорошо даётся, — математика.» replaces «Лучше всего мне даётся математика», matching EN "My strong subject is mathematics." Two optional comprehensibility notes were adopted on the same Japanese evidence: 引っ張る renders ロープを強く引っ張ってください without the comparative («Пожалуйста, сильно тяните верёвку.»), and 年齢 renders 参加できます as participation rather than registration («В этом курсе можно участвовать независимо от возраста.»). Before the candidate, the coordinator retitled 得意 from «конёк; хорошо удающееся дело» to «сильная сторона; хорошо удающееся дело» for EN "one's strong point", because figurative «конёк» implies fondness that the card itself says 得意 does not assert. Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, reconciliation and process notes are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.

qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 25 EN exclusions across 16 lists are retained. Five direct, one-sided exclusions on four new cards cover reviewed RU title overlaps: 得意–武器 (added by the coordinator with the 得意 retitle; shared segment «сильная сторона»), 影響–左右 (shared segment «влияние») and 床–性 (shared segment «пол») are required; 効果–有効 and 影響–毒 are conservative stem guards. The author, the coordinator and the blind consistency reviewer classified all five the same way. No exclusion changed after review. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.

Mentions that EN leaves unlinked stay plain. No surrounding prose was changed. Missing kanji cards and unavailable word targets remain plain text; no substitute cards were invented.

titleDecisions.declinedOptional: Declined optional items: the consistency reviewer's suggested guards 引退↔辞める and 徹底↔丁寧 (medium confidence), 心理↔精神 and 得意↔自慢 (low) and the weaker pairs 当時↔昔, 幼い↔若い, 従う↔守る, 役割↔担当, 従兄弟↔親戚, 強盗↔犯人, 年齢↔歳, 強力↔力 and 効果↔副作用, because EN declares none of them, the titles share no exact segment and the app deduplicates exact titles only; the reviewer accepted the decline in its recheck. The comprehensibility reviewer's optional notes on 役割 («роль насоса» renders 役割を果たす with the same meaning; the suggested nominalisation is heavier), 幼い's title «малолетний» (Kuznetsov gives the neutral childhood sense, the body renders each example naturally, and «маленький» would overlap 小さい/小さな) and 従う's slash list (each alternative is grammatical with «следовать»; «подчиняться» would drop the following sense) were not adopted; the reviewer accepted these declines in its recheck. Its 引っ張る and 年齢 notes were adopted in the fix. The consistency reviewer's initial limit about 118 strokes hash mismatches was a raw-hash artifact: the manifest hashes text after CRLF-to-LF normalization, and the reviewer withdrew the limit after confirming all 4,384 entries. No reviewer finding remains open.
